developments.reason: Reviewed Wren's round-8 request (Cultivate meadow roots: a learnable, feasible way to propagate and tend edible meadow roots, with unknown inputs and costs) and the World Agent's develop review (learning 3): a general cultivation operation with modes plant, tend, inspect and end; a hand planting trial of one whole owned root in two rounds and 3 energy (1.5 per completed round) that first prepares and records the site and then transfers the root after revalidating location, occupancy and input; a 0.2-energy probe inspection; tending only when a real input and effect are implemented, otherwise refused before costs; production only from a coded establishment and growth rule, otherwise a planting and monitoring precursor. Inspecting the handlers grounded the propagule question: the existing seed dispersal in open-ecology.ts turns one actual stock unit of any living plant (growth interval > 0, fish excluded) into a seedling 'seed or vegetative propagule' with stock 0, a stock ceiling of min(4, parent capacity), the parent's growth interval and a first dispersal 600 rounds later, which establishes and grows under the same rule as natural plants. A whole harvested unit is therefore a supported propagule and production is grounded, so this is a simplified real mechanism, not a first release. Implemented cultivate-plants@1 in scope long-ex16 (learning 3; the ability serializes to 3,025 code units). Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) whose origin is a living plant of the same food; x, y name a 0.25 m plot in reach on hand-workable ground (the existing long-planting-site rule: ordinary soil, no water or wet bank, waterlogging at most 0.1, clear of people and reserved objects) with soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and fewer than 3 plants of that food or prepared plots within 5 m (the dispersal law's own conditions). Every check runs before any cost, so a refusal spends nothing. Round 1 (1.5 energy) escrows the unit, still owned, carried and ageing, and creates the prepared plot (cultivation-site-prepared). Round 2 (1.5 energy) rechecks reach, site, unit and energy, moves the unit with its origin, mass and age into the plot as an unowned reserved stack that cannot be eaten or used, records its condition at transfer, and gives the plot exactly the seedling data the dispersal law gives a natural propagule (cultivation-propagule-planted; no food is created). The plot then gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture, waterlogging and season. At the existing threshold (12, or 60 for woody plants) the unit is absorbed into the new plant: it leaves the food stocks and its mass is recorded (cultivation-plot-established). Stock then grows by one unit per growth interval up to the ceiling (cultivation-crop-matured at the first unit) and is harvested only through unchanged gather. If the buried unit spoils first under the existing ageing law, the plot dies, stops growing and is no longer a food source (cultivation-trial-failed). An unworked round, too little energy, leaving reach or a changed site pauses without charge (cultivation-work-paused). Plant resumes the person's own unfinished work and pays only the remaining round (cultivation-work-resumed). End takes one round and no energy, acts only on the person's own unfinished work, returns the unit once in its current condition and clears the empty site (cultivation-trial-ended). Death before transfer leaves the unit where the person died. A transferred unit stays planted, and nothing is refunded. Inspect (one round, 0.2 energy) runs the baseline probe observation on a plot or plant source in reach and adds an unverified personal record of visible lifecycle, stage, stock, soil and weather (cultivation-condition-observed). Verified findings come only from the probe's existing dated-change rule, which deduplicates across probe and cultivation. Tend is refused before any cost. This scope has no carried water, fertilizer or soil amendment, no input can change a plot's moisture, and crowding affects only dispersal, so no treatment input or effect exists and treatment_applied is never emitted. Also not implemented: destructive sampling of a planted specimen (the probe's material modes need an owned unreserved stack and measure load, water or heat response, not viability, and digging up a buried unit is not represented; a unit can still be probed before planting), a stressed label, and any satisfaction. The planting event carries no qualified flag, so no practice milestone, short pleasure or care satisfaction is awarded, and planting or failure gives no nutrition or comfort. Modeling assumptions: a whole harvested unit of a living plant is that plant's propagule, as in the dispersal law, for every food with a growth cycle and an ageing lifetime (so the root and berry, and also nuts, fruit, tubers and fungi). Hand preparation is limited to ordinary soil and needs no tool. The site conditions are the dispersal law's. Hand-loosened soil is not a lasting represented state, so ending or failing before transfer leaves no object. Water and nutrients are represented only by the growth rule's climate moisture, soil moisture, waterlogging and depletion terms, with no separate ledger. The plot keeps the source's growth interval and a stock ceiling of at most 4. A dead plot stays as an empty marked position. Plants that an established plot later disperses are ordinary plants. Reuse is recorded in the package: ex15 cultivation-trial@1's law constants, treated-unit list, ageing, plant, observation-input, footprint and reach helpers through new exports that leave ex15 behavior unchanged (ex7-ex15 replay compatibility identical), and its cultivation-trial drawing; also the unchanged open-ecology.ts growth law, forest-environment.ts ageing, long-planting-site.ts, collective-work.ts escrow and paid work, open-foundation.ts probe and personal records, and base gather. Tests cover learning, the paid rounds, conservation, establishment equal to a natural control seedling, absorption, stock and gather, rot failure, cost-free refusals, pause, resume and planter-only end, inspection, another food (berry), dispersed offspring and death.

reviews.specification:
Implement Construct branch screen as a general operation with modes assess, assemble, inspect, repair and dismantle, parameterized by site coordinates, orientation, explicit owned input-stack IDs and quantities, or an existing project/structure ID. Applicable actors learn it independently. Minimum supported product is an unroofed, approximately 0.9 m wide and 0.4–0.45 m high porous woven branch screen; no shelter, roof, fire protection or storm resistance is implied. Use a deterministic implementation of suitability, work, stability, damage and exposure, not repeated model judgments. Dependencies are actual spatial reach/occupancy, inventory transfers, material properties, ground resistance and measured weather/exposure. If these mechanisms are missing, implement the necessary bounded checks in this handoff; never substitute successful construction for unavailable evidence.
Material recipe: three sound naturally pointed upright pieces about 0.65–0.75 m long and 2–3 cm thick, inserted at least 0.25 m into suitable soil at approximately 0, 0.45 and 0.9 m along the screen, plus eight sound flexible rods about 1.0–1.2 m long and 1–2 cm thick. Alternate weaving around the three uprights, retaining ends and leaving distributed openings rather than making a solid wall. Confirm actual fit, spring-back and retention during assembly. These are eleven qualifying pieces, not automatically eleven resource units: preserve actual inventory quantities and mass, and establish how existing branch units map to pieces before committing a recipe. No cutting, sharpening, cord, tools, stones or water are supplied or assumed. No other material is required for this version if hand insertion and weaving genuinely work. If suitable pieces or soil are unavailable, assess records the measured deficiency and permits only the feasible ground/support trial, not a completed windbreak.
Site: a reachable, clear footprint at least 1.2 by 0.6 m beside, not across, the resting location; no occupied path, entrance, person, protected vegetation or living-tree attachment. Check lawful access under existing permissions rather than granting permission. Ground must admit hand insertion and then retain the posts without loose, saturated or rocky failure. Maintain a clear resting area beyond the possible fall footprint. Orient using actual local wind observations; do not assume a prevailing direction. Initial assess takes one round and 0.2 energy for visible conditions, using probe-compatible observation. A physical support trial takes one round and 0.5 energy and requires one suitable owned post. Record actual insertion, resistance and any damage; an intact post remains recoverable, and any breakage becomes tracked damaged material. It does not consume the baseline probe sample automatically or create a support.
Acquisition uses gather with exact visible source IDs, for example start-2-branches, forest-branch-0, canopy-41 or canopy-69, subject to current stock, reach and the full gather contract. Do not reserve or reveal unobserved stock. Gather costs 2 energy per transferred resource unit and one round per execution. Eleven qualifying one-unit pieces would therefore cost 22 energy, plus actual travel and handling; suitability is not guaranteed. Navigation retains navigate/base:navigate:1 travel costs. Sol owns berries, not construction inputs, and has energy 40; do not automatically gather, spend berries or assume enough energy for every stage without rest.
After learning and a valid trial, assemble requires all specified pieces owned and in reach. Allocate them once to a visible project with exact source-stack provenance; subtract them from freely usable inventory without duplicating material. Eight paid work rounds at 1.5 energy each: two rounds seating and checking uprights, four weaving and retaining rods, one gap/alignment correction and one stability check. Each stage records installed pieces and observable progress. These are active-work minima; failed fit, additional gathering, travel or waiting takes real additional time. Require sufficient energy before each paid round. Perform a low-force hand stability check and record displacement and loose components against a coded acceptance threshold appropriate to the declared dimensions and actual ground/material properties. Completion requires every connection and support passing; a failed check leaves an incomplete or unstable structure, not success. No guaranteed wind-reduction percentage is assigned.
Leaving reach, insufficient energy, occupancy changes or an invalid site pauses before further work and without additional charge. Resume by project ID after rechecking site, inputs, integrity and energy; retain completed work and costs. Cancel stops queued work, returns uninstalled surviving escrow once, and leaves installed pieces as an explicitly incomplete physical project until dismantled. Death stops work; uninstalled escrow becomes recoverable material at the work/death location under existing ownership/death rules, while installed material remains in place. Never refund spent time or energy. Global pauses preserve progress and costs. Prevent concurrent use of allocated material and double returns.
Inspect takes one reachable round and 0.2 energy and reports only observable integrity, gaps and local exposure. Repair specifies damaged components and owned replacements; one removal and one fitting round per replaced piece, each 1.5 energy, followed by the one-round 1.5-energy stability check. Reuse intact components; preserve removed broken material as debris with its remaining mass and properties. Dismantle takes one round per three installed pieces, rounded up, at 1 energy per round; recover only actually surviving pieces, decrementing the structure as each group is removed. No energy, time or damage refund.
A completed screen persists physically without continued work but is checked by ongoing weather, collision and decay rules. Its solids affect passage only at actual occupied geometry. Wind effects apply only to reachable occupied locations in its small leeward footprint, using current wind direction/speed, height, porosity and integrity; absent a credible local exposure calculation, show an unverified screen and allow measured exposure comparison, not a fabricated shelter bonus. No roof, rainproofing, heating or food is produced. Wind shifts remove coverage; breakage or loosened posts reduce or end it immediately and can leave fallen material. Inspection is advisable after gusts and before use; there is no automatic repair or recurring material charge without work. Use rest (base:rest:1; forest.rest, foundation-forest@1) unchanged unless its implemented facility/exposure rules actually recognize this structure; never stack duplicate rest or comfort bonuses.

args.name: Build a small branch windbreak
args.function: Learn a feasible method for constructing a stable, modest branch windbreak beside an outdoor resting place, with an open woven form if feasible.
args.conditions: I am outdoors, with fallen-branch sources visible nearby. I have not gathered or tested branches and know no construction method. Avoid obstructing people or damaging living trees.
args.inputs: Potential fallen branches gathered locally. Identify any other necessary materials, suitable site requirements, and actual quantities before construction.
args.costs: Unknown. Specify realistic materials, effort, learning time, and construction time. I do not yet possess building materials or personal construction mastery.
args.effects: Enable actual construction only after learning and acquiring sufficient materials. Stability and any wind reduction must follow real construction and conditions; requesting alone creates no shelter or happiness.

candidates.function: Plant one owned food unit from a living plant in a small hand-prepared soil plot, where it may establish as a new plant under the existing plant rules; inspect plots or plant sources; end unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. Plant: inputStackId names one whole owned, untreated, unspoiled food unit (quantity 1) gathered from a living plant; x, y a 0.25 m plot within reach on ordinary meadow soil (.), waterlogging at most 0.1, soil moisture 0.3-1.2, 0.6 m clear of objects and people, with fewer than 3 plants of that food within 5 m. Two paid rounds of 1.5 energy: prepare the site, then transfer the unit; the action continues itself, and plant resumes paused work after rechecking reach, site, unit and energy. Inspect: target a plot or plant source in reach; one round, 0.2 energy (baseline probe observation). End: stops unfinished planting; one round, no energy. Tend is refused at no cost: no water, fertilizer or other treatment exists yet. Harvest uses gather. No tool, water or seed is provided.
candidates.effects: Preparing keeps the unit carried, owned and ageing. Transfer moves it, with origin and age, into the plot, where it cannot be eaten or used; the plot becomes a propagule exactly like a naturally dispersed one. It gains establishment only from actual temperature, light, soil moisture and season, so cold, darkness or drought stall it; if the buried unit spoils first, the plot dies. On establishing, the unit becomes a new plant with no stock and a ceiling of at most 4, regrowing under the natural rule, harvested by anyone through gather; nothing is copied or guaranteed. Inspect records only visible stage, stock, soil and weather as an unverified personal record. An unworked round pauses; low energy, leaving reach or a changed site pause without charge; a lost or spoiled unit stops the work. End, or death, before transfer returns the unit once (where the person died); a transferred unit stays planted. No reward or refund.
